description: List sites for the team this connection belongs to.

includeDeleted.description: If true, include soft-deleted sites still in their plan-specific recovery window (status: 'deleted'). Defaults to false: deleted sites can't accept deploys, so an agent rarely wants them in a working list. Use true when you specifically need the recovery view.

name: list_sites

lastDeploySource.description: How the most recent deploy was triggered, or null if never deployed. Observed values: mcp, magic-file, git, quick-deploy, zip, ai-generate, staging, promote, rollback, manual-snapshot. New sources can be added by other code paths, so treat this as a hint, not a closed enum.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Sites are usable only in 'active'. 'deleted' is the soft-delete bucket (in recovery window). 'deleting' is the transient state during an in-flight hard-delete request. list_sites excludes 'deleted' by default.

title: List your sites
